definition: The number that GitHub gives to an account, for example 3068563. It never changes. The login of the same account can change.
The name that a person writes in the GitHub profile, for example “Kenji Mori”. It is not the login, and two people can have the same one.
A number of one variant. It starts at 0, and each saved decision for the variant adds 1. A decision carries the number that the page saw, and the service refuses a decision with an old number.
The number of rows that D1 writes for a statement. An index entry counts as one more row. D1 reports and bills this number.
